name: io.github.Bekhouche/wc3files
title: wc3files
description: Read and edit Warcraft III maps, objects, triggers, scripts, models and replays. Edits are opt-in.

packageArguments.name: --root
packageArguments.description: A folder the tools may use: maps, models or replays. Repeat it for more folders.

packageArguments.name: --allow-write
packageArguments.description: Also give the edit tools, which write edited maps as new files under the roots. Without it every tool only reads.
